subject.title: fix(tui): prevent duplicate session rollover after stale terminal redraw

question: Should this protected TUI test-harness change be accepted after exact-head PTY proof confirms that removing genuine busy retries does not weaken local or Gateway rollover coverage?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires human handling, and the PR changes the test synchronization contract rather than production behavior while relying on an uninspected claimed regression run.

options.title: Request exact-head PTY proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or hosted PTY transcript that shows one rollover command, the new session becoming idle, and the next prompt succeeding.

options.title: Accept the harness contract
options.body: Accept the single-submit assumption if the responsible reviewer confirms the callers already guarantee completion of the prior turn.

recommendation.title: Request exact-head PTY proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or hosted PTY transcript that shows one rollover command, the new session becoming idle, and the next prompt succeeding.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the proposed TUI test-harness contract and can provide the requested exact-head evidence.
